title: The Delayed Countdown Method for Validating Review-Oriented AI Workflows in eDiscovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.31311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Review-oriented workflows have become the dominant approach to AI-assisted document review in electronic discovery (eDiscovery). How to validate the effectiveness of review-oriented workflows has, however, remained a confusing and controversial topic in technology-assisted review (TAR) in the law. We examine the sources of this controversy, and propose a simple and practical evaluation approach for review-oriented workflows. Our Delayed Countdown method is easily incorporated into existing review-oriented workflows and software, is compatible with arbitrary stopping rules, and produces valid frequentist confidence intervals on effectiveness. We explain the conceptual foundations of the method, provide example computations, discuss the handling of logically impossible recall values, and suggest future work on decreasing review costs.

translated_title: 用于验证电子取证中审查导向型AI工作流的延迟倒计时方法
translated_abstract: 面向审查的工作流已成为电子取证中AI辅助文档审查的主流方法。然而，如何验证审查导向型工作流的有效性，一直是法律领域技术辅助审查（TAR）中一个令人困惑且充满争议的话题。我们分析了这一争议的根源，并为审查导向型工作流提出了一种简单而实用的评估方法。我们的延迟倒计时方法易于融入现有的审查导向型工作流和软件中，兼容任意停止规则，并能产生关于有效性的有效频率学派置信区间。我们阐释了该方法的概念基础，提供了示例计算，讨论了对逻辑上不可能的召回率值的处理，并就降低审查成本的后续研究提出了建议。
tldr: 本文提出延迟倒计时方法，为电子取证中审查导向型AI工作流的有效性验证提供了一种简单实用、易于集成、兼容任意停止规则并能给出有效置信区间的评估方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Delayed Countdown method, a simple and practical approach for validating review-oriented AI workflows in eDiscovery that easily integrates with existing software, is compatible with arbitrary stopping rules, and produces valid frequentist confidence intervals on effectiveness.
